name: git_commit_date
hints:
Start with interactive rebase. To change the date of the last 5 commits:
git rebase -i HEAD~5
In the editor, change 'pick' with 'edit' and save (:wq)

Repeat the following 5 times: 
GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="$(date)" git commit --amend --no-edit --date "$(date)"
git rebase --continue
